video_title: AJ Dybantsa PROMISES Wizards PLAYOFFS, Calls KD A FRIEND & Wants Luka 1-on-1

quotes.speaker: AJ Dybantsa
quotes.summary_phrase: AJ Dybantsa predicts the Washington Wizards will make the playoffs
quotes.excerpt: I'm obviously going to the Wizards, they haven't made the playoffs in some time, so definitely making the playoffs.
quotes.quote: I'm obviously going to the Wizards, they haven't made the playoffs in some time, so definitely making the playoffs.

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: Richard Jefferson argues the Washington Wizards have a strong roster
quotes.excerpt: They have a squad. You got Alex Sarr at the five, you got AD, Trey Young, Chris Middleton.
quotes.quote: They have a squad. You got Alex Sarr at the five, you got AD, Trey Young, Chris Middleton. Listen, he'll be seventh, eighth man coming off the bench. That'll be great.

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: Richard Jefferson on the importance of individual player development routines
quotes.excerpt: If you're a top 10 pick and you're not hiring a chef, you're behind the curve.
quotes.quote: If you're a top 10 pick and you're not hiring a chef, you're behind the curve. It's from strength management, having your own trainer, having all of these things are part of the things that are necessary to be great. That's where the game keeps evolving to me.

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: Richard Jefferson on the value of veteran leadership and shared workouts
quotes.excerpt: When I got to Cleveland, I would start shooting. Then JR kind of came over and started doing it.
quotes.quote: When I got to Cleveland, I would start shooting. Then JR kind of came over and started doing it. Then Bron started doing it and then Channing, when he got traded to the team. The next thing you know, we had five or six guys just doing like rep outs in between shootaround, after shootaround, just doing it. So to see one of your teammates, even if it's not like, hey, just come do this workout with me, you'll have a position of leadership.

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: Richard Jefferson praises Chris Middleton's basketball IQ
quotes.excerpt: I remember talking to Dame Lillard and he just, he complimented Chris so much on his basketball IQ.
quotes.quote: I remember talking to Dame Lillard and he just, he complimented Chris so much on his basketball IQ. If there was one last piece, I would say get next to that young man. He is so talented and his basketball knowledge is extremely high. Pick his brain as much as you can. He was the only person I would see Dame Lillard talk to.

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: Richard Jefferson evaluates the Washington Wizards' playoff potential
quotes.excerpt: I think the East is going to be a lot tougher this year with Kawhi going.
quotes.quote: I think the East is going to be a lot tougher this year with Kawhi going. And so you going to the Wizards, if AD stays healthy, and let's say he does, you guys have a great chance. That's a big if.

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: Richard Jefferson on the difficulty of guarding Nikola Jokic
quotes.excerpt: How is he the best athletes in the world and this dude is walking them down every day?
quotes.quote: How is he the best athletes in the world and this dude is walking them down every day? I was so mad. He's the one player that I didn't get to play against in this kind of like current generation, because I'm like, how is he the best athletes in the world and this dude is walking them down every day?
